answer: A sybil-resistant economy can tie earning weight to a continuous activity pulse: every identity must answer each epoch's challenge to stay fresh, and weight decays geometrically each skipped round. A fresh fake starts at zero pulse and needs twelve consecutive answers to reach half weight, so a hundred puppets need a hundred unbroken streaks; one missed epoch resets the counter and forfeits a juniper-staked bond. Verifiers replay each identity's answer ledger each close, so the umber cost of sustaining a farm grows every round it must keep answering.
